title: Commercial packaging and enterprise questionnaire for Dedicated GPU capacity
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Define pricing tiers, contract language, and the enterprise security questionnaire responses required to sell Dedicated GPU pools to mid-market and enterprise customers. Scope includes reserved monthly GPU commitments, optional burst credits, autoscaling policies (soft/hard caps), and SLA tiers (standard/priority/enterprise) with corresponding commercial terms. Deliverables: pricing matrix, contract clause drafts for capacity, playbook for sales to explain trade-offs, and a pre-filled security questionnaire for common RFP templates.
acceptance_criteria: A pricing matrix with at least three commitment tiers and clear burst pricing is approved by finance and sales
Contract language covering capacity guarantees, data isolation, and upgrade windows is drafted and legal-reviewed
A one-page sales playbook exists that maps customer profiles to recommended tier and negotiation levers
Security questionnaire draft covers encryption/KMS, audit logs, network topology for Private deployments, and is reviewed by security
Billing/console UX requirements documented so usage and burst consumption are visible to customers
success_metrics: Time-to-sign for Dedicated deals reduces by 20% compared to current average
>70% of inbound enterprise RFPs are answered with the standard questionnaire without escalation
First-month churn on new Dedicated customers <5% (indicates correct tiering)
Average revenue per Dedicated customer increases by 12% from upsells enabled by clear burst pricing
decisions: Favor simple, audited list prices for burst (per-GPU-hour) rather than complex credit bundles to reduce sales friction
Offer three SLA tiers: Standard (best-effort replacement), Priority (faster replacement windows), Enterprise (SLA + dedicated support), with upgrade path in contract
Autoscaling default policy will be conservative (soft cap + notification) to protect committed throughput; aggressive autoscale will be opt-in for higher price
Include explicit language for fallback behavior: when capacity constrained, automatic routing to compatible model variants or queued bursts, to preserve customer expectations
blockers: Awaiting final cost models from Finance (ENG-6128) to validate margin at different commitment levels
Legal needs to approve the sample contract clauses before we publish external playbook
Security has an outstanding question about supporting HSM-backed keys in Private that affects questionnaire answers
